releaseNotes: 接入 Sparkle 应用内安全更新：更新包与更新清单均经过 Ed25519 签名验证，后续版本优先通过 EdgeOne 与香港 COS 检查和下载，同时保留 GitHub Release 作为海外镜像与手动下载入口。
releaseNotesEn: Adds secure in-app updates with Sparkle. Update archives and the update feed are verified with Ed25519 signatures; future releases prefer EdgeOne and Hong Kong COS while retaining GitHub Releases as an overseas mirror and manual download option.
